data.one_liner: Utilities for working with chunked streams such as Stream<List<int>>
data.what_it_does: Provides helpers to read byte streams into a single Uint8List and to iterate over chunked streams element‑by‑element. It also offers a utility to wrap any Stream<T> as a chunked Stream<List<T>>.
use_when: Reading a file or network response as a byte stream and converting it to a single buffer
Iterating over a byte stream one byte or a fixed number of bytes at a time
Wrapping a non‑chunked stream into a chunked form for batch processing
avoid_when: When you need advanced stream manipulation beyond simple chunking, consider using the async package’s ChunkedStreamReader directly
strengths: Simple API with readByteStream and readBytes
Supports both reading entire streams and incremental iteration
Cross‑platform support (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: ChunkedStreamIterator is deprecated in favor of async’s ChunkedStreamReader
Very small feature set – only basic chunk handling
